title: Driving Jay around in a Model A Ford
summary: Gus drove Jay in a Model A while Jay greeted everyone on the street, and once ran into the back of another car.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Oh, he was always drunk [at night], but I'd get him up so he could make his job, one of those things. But he wasn't the kind that would really mess up on the job.
No, no. Because he's quiet, really.

I had a little Model A Ford, and we would drive up and down the streets, going about ten miles an hour. And he would speak to everybody on the street. That was his thing. "Howdy-do, how are you? You're looking so beautiful today, one of those things."
And I'm sitting up there behind the wheel, driving. "Good evening." Then he would say, "Oh, they say we're the nicest fellows in town."

And I was driving his car one day and I turned my head. There was a car in front of me, and all of a sudden I looked up and there I was. I put on the brakes and skid and -- bam, right in the back of the car. But the fenders -- bumpers hit each other. The guy jumped out of the car and come around, "What the hell wrong with you? Can't you drive that car?" Said, "Don't you have any brakes?" I said, "Yeah, don't you see where I slid?" (Laughter.) He couldn't say anything, he just got in his car and left.
Was Jay still greeting people on the sidewalk?
Jay said, "W., are you drunk?" I said, "No, I'm not drunk. He just had no business stopping like that in front of me." I turned my head and I didn't see him. I just run right in the back of him.
